assertions.name: toy1_geometric_unit_kernel_all_c_k_eq_neg_one
assertions.source: Toy 1: depth-1 geometric kernel g = 1, seed c_2 = -1. Recursion produces c_k = -1 for all k. Validates the applyRecursion machinery and confirms the 'even rungs geometric' pattern note of qbeta-1ppq-achieved.

assertions.name: toy2_depth2_c_4_matches_fit
assertions.source: Toy 2: depth-2 kernel (a=0.5, b=-0.02843) constructed by inverting the c_4 fit value -0.97157 from qbeta-1ppq-achieved. Validates that the depth-2 recursion engine reproduces the fit by construction; extends to c_5, c_6, etc. predictions for that kernel.

description: Recursion engine for the c_k precision ladder + demonstration on toy kernels. Implements `CKRecursion.apply_recursion` mirroring the Lean structure of the same name. The proved seed c_2 = -1 (PR #1602) is the input; toy kernels (depth-1 geometric; depth-2 fit-to-c_4) generate c_4..c_8 mechanically. Scaffold — no claim about which kernel is the Q_β-categorical one (that requires symbolic α(q), open object).

scaffold_status.open_object: categorical kernel R(q,ξ) for the fibre-level Habiro element F(q) = Q_β / [Q_A · cos(α_eff)]; requires symbolic α(q) from the operator-valued N=3 witness.
